name: OpenCode Go
description: Serves an OpenCode Go subscription through CLIProxyAPI: the Go models of a workspace over Chat Completions, Messages and Responses, the workspace's opt-in OpenCode Zen pay-as-you-go models as opencode/... next to them, an OpenCode login from the OAuth Login page or keys on a Management Center page that also enables and disables models and shares bare model IDs with other providers, and 5-hour, weekly and monthly quota in the Plugin tab.
author: Whexy
